Definition: {something written, i.e. a writing, record or book}
BiblicalUsage: Kethab means something written, a writing, a record, a book: Ezra 7:22 gives salt without prescribing how much, the king's order written down. Daniel 5:7 has the king crying, whosoever shall read this writing, and shew me the interpretation, shall be clothed with scarlet. Daniel 5:8 says the wise men could not read the writing. Daniel 5:15 says they could not shew the interpretation of the thing.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe writing is the test of every kingdom: the king's order is written and obeyed, but God's writing on the wall no wise man can read. I hold that the only writing that matters in the end is the one God's finger writes.
